## Editorial contract

Brand: **FrankX** (`frankx`)

- Read `CREATOR.md` before changing public or customer-facing copy.
- Apply the registered brand voice and the shared editorial gate.
- Reject generated prestige language, rhetorical contrast formulas, invented claims, and abstract labels that hide simple facts.
- Keep public labels in sentence case.
- Run the changed-copy editorial audit before release.

Pinned source: https://github.com/Starlight-Intelligence/starlight-design-intelligence/blob/851a11be31a0640df64baabcf2b1fc1afb9ce849/brand-packs/frankx/COPY.md

## Correctness and release review

Follow AGENTS.md and its homepage-preservation contract. Cite the full reviewed head
and identify unread files. Flag stale or missing required checks, skipped dependency
jobs presented as release evidence, check-name collisions, unsafe privileged-trigger
execution and assertions of review independence without maker/provider evidence.
For email, auth and money paths, verify denial behavior and zero external calls when
unauthorized. Keep every existing human release gate; do not treat a review as approval
to merge or deploy. Added by Codex, 3 November 2026, revision 1.
